author: Raymundo Rodrigues
title: Incredible dude
text: Incredible dude, I had a lot of fun working with him, he was always available for any questions I had, did everything in the background and helped me migrate the website, the experience was a 10/10, he broke down complex subjects into simple terms, he was very fast during each step of the process, his positive energy radiating through the calls, overall enjoyed working with him very much!

descriptor.en: Voice actor in English, Italian and Bulgarian
